tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Raising of 10x16 Size 40000 Seedlings at RFO Office Compound Nursery of Honnali Range during 2026-27 (Reserved for Category-SC )

itemList.description: Cost of raising of 4"x6" seedlings for trasplanting into 10"x16" PBs
Cost of HDPE Woven bags including 18% GST

Procurement of 2.0525 cum. Farm Yard Manure / Compost, 2.0525 cum. of Sand and 4.105 cum of Redearth i.e. totally 8.21 cum. (Ingredient ratio FYM : Sand : Red earth = 1:1:2) (8.72 cum needed for 10" x16" minus 0.51 cum of transplanted 4"x6" bag).
Mixing the ingredients, filling the polythene bags and arranging in rows after scraping the earth.
Transplanting of 4” x 6” size bagged seedlings into 10” x 16” size bags after removal of the seedlings along with the trimmed ball of earth
Cost of collection of 8-10 ft. long stakes of 'Chewa' or split dowga bamboos from departmental forest / plantation for providing vertical support to each plant including delivery at nursery site.
Tying of plant to the vertical stake, and pruning of buds as it grows once in a fortnight
Watering to the Polythene bagged seedlings twice a day from 01.07.2026 to 31.03.2027 (Limitted to 240 days).
Shifting and grading the polythene-bagged seedlings.
Procurement of plant protection and growth promotion materials/compounds, their application, nursery pumpset fuel/maintainence/ electricty bill of pumpset and other unforseen items and charges
